column1: # merge-pr: does this workflow file start a run when a draft PR is marked ready?
# Read by BOTH ports (ready_trigger / Test-ReadyTrigger). A false no merges a PR
# before the CI its ready flip starts has run; a false yes holds the merge until a
# check that never comes and refuses it.
# "\n" in the text is a newline, "-" an empty string.

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
jobs:
  check:
    if: github.event.pull_request.draft == false

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    types: [opened,
      ready_for_review]

name: ci
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [ready_for_review] # the draft-skip job

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, ready_for_review]
    paths: ['packages/api/**']
